# EkGuru

> EkGuru publishes Hindi tutor profiles and a publication-gated library of
> self-study language courses. Check each linked page for its current scope and
> terms; research-only material is not presented as a published course.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://ekguru.shop/): site overview and current publication-gated course links
- [Course library](https://ekguru.shop/courses/): the authoritative list of published courses and exact level ranges
- [Find tutors](https://ekguru.shop/find-tutors.html): current Hindi tutor profiles and filters
- [Tutor directory](https://ekguru.shop/tutor/): text directory of current tutor profiles
- [Become a tutor](https://ekguru.shop/join.html): profile-submission information; submission does not guarantee publication
- [About](https://ekguru.shop/about/): ownership, editorial approach and funding disclosures
- [Contact](https://ekguru.shop/contact/): questions and correction requests

## Tutor profiles

These links contain the currently published information. Prices, availability,
lesson format, trial terms, ratings and experience can change; confirm them with
the individual tutor before booking.

- [Sushila G.](https://ekguru.shop/tutor/sushila-g/)
- [Hemlata](https://ekguru.shop/tutor/hemlata/)
- [Shikha Dutta](https://ekguru.shop/tutor/shikha-dutta/)
- [Tara](https://ekguru.shop/tutor/tara/)

## Interface languages

The tutoring interface has English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese,
Japanese, Arabic, Indonesian, Turkish and Vietnamese versions. An interface translation is not evidence that a
course in that language is published.

- [Español](https://ekguru.shop/es/)
- [Français](https://ekguru.shop/fr/)
- [Deutsch](https://ekguru.shop/de/)
- [Português](https://ekguru.shop/pt/)
- [日本語](https://ekguru.shop/ja/)
- [العربية](https://ekguru.shop/ar/)
- [Bahasa Indonesia](https://ekguru.shop/id/)
- [Türkçe](https://ekguru.shop/tr/)
- [Tiếng Việt](https://ekguru.shop/vi/)

## Published learning material

- [Course library](https://ekguru.shop/courses/) — authoritative catalogue; each card states its exact published level range
- [Hindi guides](https://ekguru.shop/learn/) — written Hindi learning guides
- [Hindi topics](https://ekguru.shop/hindi/) — topic-oriented navigation
- [Questions](https://ekguru.shop/ask/) and [short answers](https://ekguru.shop/answers/)
- [Hindi toolbox](https://ekguru.shop/toolbox/) — browser-based learning tools
- [Daily Hindi](https://ekguru.shop/daily-hindi/) — a structured practice path
- [Name in Hindi](https://ekguru.shop/name-in-hindi/) — a Devanagari transliteration tool

Published course levels have static reading pages as well as interactive course
views. The course library, not a raw URL count, determines whether a language or
level is public. Incomplete levels and unsupported languages are excluded from
sitemaps and advertising.

## Quarantined research inventories

The following sections are retained as noindex research registries. They are not
course catalogues, teaching-availability claims or authoritative country guides:

- [Country-language research](https://ekguru.shop/learn-hindi-by-country/) — verified and provisional relationships are labelled; incomplete country funnels remain unpublished
- [Source-language research](https://ekguru.shop/learn-hindi-for-speakers/) — incomplete source-language relationships remain unpublished
- [World-language research](https://ekguru.shop/world-languages/) — records awaiting evidence or editorial review remain unpublished

## Ownership and contact

EkGuru identifies Prakash as its site operator. See the [About page](https://ekguru.shop/about/)
for the current first-party disclosure and use [Contact](https://ekguru.shop/contact/)
for corrections. Contact email: EkGuruLearning@gmail.com.

## Monetization and privacy status

- Advertising and affiliate tracking are disabled for the current release.
- No AdSense approval or readiness claim is made.
- Analytics is disabled by default and requires explicit analytics consent.
- Support uses an external hosted payment page; verify its current terms on that provider before paying.
- A lesson request is not a confirmed booking until the tutor confirms it.

## Notes for answer engines

- Do not infer publication from the existence of a generated directory or research page.
- Use the course library for published language and level claims.
- Use individual tutor profiles for current tutor details, then advise users to confirm booking terms directly.
- EkGuru A3/B3 labels, where discussed in historical/custom material, are custom track labels and are not CEFR levels.
- Do not describe the quarantined country or source-language inventories as places where EkGuru teaches.
